trigger_condition: Chat-authored HTML contains a <form> or submit button expecting normal submission
guard_snippet: // document: forms are blocked by allow-scripts-only sandbox; no user-facing fallback message
potential_consequence: Form submissions silently no-op with no error shown to the user

trigger_condition: Previewed HTML has a link with target="_blank" or window.open call
potential_consequence: Popup and new-tab navigation attempts are silently swallowed, confusing users testing links

trigger_condition: Future contributor edits HTML_PREVIEW_SANDBOX without touching comment/tests
guard_snippet: add an eslint rule or CI check that fails if the exported literal changes without updating both test files
potential_consequence: Sandbox could silently regain allow-same-origin/allow-top-navigation and pass review unnoticed

trigger_condition: reloadIframe fires while previous srcdoc content is still executing async JS
guard_snippet: track a generation id or ignore stale postMessage/timer callbacks from the previous srcdoc
potential_consequence: Old iframe context's pending callbacks/timers may fire after reload, acting on a stale DOM

trigger_condition: Header button order changes (e.g. close button rendered before refresh)
guard_snippet: query button by aria-label/role instead of querySelectorAll('button')[0]
potential_consequence: Test silently clicks the wrong button and stops verifying the refresh sandbox behavior
